info.name: Digimine PDF Export POC
info.description:
Unified Export API: PDF, Excel (.xlsx), and HTML via a single POST /api/export endpoint.

Base URL: http://localhost:5000

request.description: Extracts widgets marked with [data-widget] into separate Excel sheets.
Exports HTML directly to a print-ready PDF using headless Chromium.
Exports a self-contained offline HTML file.
Exports any public web page URL to PDF via Playwright.
